title: Security group open to the world (0.0.0.0/0) — review required
description: An ingress CIDR list contains 0.0.0.0/0, so the port accepts traffic from the entire internet, including scanners and botnets. This lexical rule flags the open CIDR; the reviewer scopes it to the networks that genuinely need access.
remediation: Replace 0.0.0.0/0 with the exact caller CIDRs (office, VPN, load balancer). Prefer security-group references over raw CIDRs and re-audit on every network change.
limitation: Lexical, single-line: CIDRs built by variables or spread across lines are missed. IPv6 open ingress (::/0) is out of scope for this rule.
